# Maui Power Equipment

> Locally owned outdoor power equipment dealer at 970 Lower Main St, Wailuku, HI 96793 (Maui). Sales, walk-in service (no appointment needed), and parts for STIHL, Honda, SCAG, Wright, ECHO, Shindaiwa, Maruyama, Hustler, Greenworks Commercial, Toro and Rolux, plus Big Tex trailers. Phone (808) 249-2730. Email Info@mauipowerequipment.com. Open Mon–Fri 7:30am–4:30pm, Sat 7:30am–2:00pm, closed Sunday.

## Main
- [Home](https://mauipowerequipment.com/): Services, hours, contact, and parts requests
- [Equipment we carry](https://mauipowerequipment.com/inventory-static.html): Full equipment list for the Wailuku store
